# MN Legal — MN Advocates LLP
> Kenya's specialist law firm in Data Privacy, AI Governance, Legal Technology, and Corporate Commercial Law. Based in Nairobi, serving Kenya and East Africa.

## About
MN Advocates LLP (trading as MN Legal) is a Nairobi-based law firm specialising in the intersection of law and technology. Founded by Mbula Nzuki, the firm advises businesses, startups, financial institutions, and multinationals on legal matters across Data Privacy, Corporate Commercial Law, Litigation, Conveyancing, Intellectual Property, Banking & Fintech, and Employment Law.

- Website: https://mnlegal.net
- Email: info@mnlegal.net
- Phone: +254 700 325 089
- Address: Global Center, 1st Floor, CBC Building, Off Argwings Kodhek Road, Kilimani, Nairobi, Kenya

## Practice Areas
- [Data Privacy & Protection](/practice-areas/data-privacy) — Data Protection Act 2019 compliance, DPIAs, AI governance, GDPR advisory
- [Corporate & Commercial Law](/practice-areas/corporate-commercial) — Company incorporation, M&A, corporate governance, commercial contracts
- [Litigation & Dispute Resolution](/practice-areas/litigation-dispute-resolution) — Commercial litigation, arbitration, mediation, debt recovery
- [Conveyancing & Property Law](/practice-areas/conveyancing-property) — Real estate transactions, land due diligence, leases, mortgages
- [Intellectual Property](/practice-areas/intellectual-property) — Trademark registration, patents, copyright, IP litigation
- [Banking, Finance & Fintech Law](/practice-areas/banking-finance-fintech) — CBK compliance, VASP advisory, fintech licensing, capital markets
- [Employment & Labour Law](/practice-areas/employment-labour) — Employment contracts, HR policies, redundancy, workplace disputes

- One of Kenya's first law firms to analyse the Kenya AI Bill 2026
- Specialist advisors on the VASP Act 2025 for digital asset operators

- International arbitration capability through London-based Of Counsel
